question: On newly prespecified Synthetic W1 fixtures, does one target-rider-excluded same-line peer PRE mean provide stable incremental proper-scoring information beyond frozen C1, without retuning or using the retrospective favorable PEER diagnostic to optimize the candidate?
hypothesis: Target-rider-excluded same-line peer PRE score information may contain signal about W1 shared line state beyond the target rider's already-used individual PRE score.
scientific_success_rule: A valid PASS, FAIL, or INCONCLUSIVE result is scientific success. The candidate is not required to beat N1 or C0, and no architecture winner is selected.

fixed_candidate.feature: peer_mean_score_i = mean(score_j for riders j with same line_group_id as i and car_no_j != car_no_i) when line_size_i > 1; peer_mean_score_i = 0.0 when line_size_i == 1
fixed_candidate.normalization: arithmetic mean over exactly line_size_i - 1 peers; no original-line-size denominator; singleton zero
fixed_candidate.coefficient_source: canonical W1 static shared-state coefficient in digital_twin_v1._static_utilities
fixed_candidate.generator: exact same Plackett-Luce ordered-top3 generator as C1

primary_metric.name: mean exact expected ordered-top3 log loss under canonical W1 truth

secondary_context_only: rank1/rank2/rank3 chain cross-entropy decomposition for all four fixed models

PASS.block_stability: candidate_minus_C1 < -1e-12 in at least 3 of 4 blocks
PASS.meaning: Prospective Synthetic evidence supports advancing this exact peer PRE representation as a Research/Candidate hypothesis only. No real-world or promotion inference.

FAIL.block_stability: candidate_minus_C1 > +1e-12 in at least 3 of 4 blocks
FAIL.meaning: Candidate hypothesis is rejected on the prospective Synthetic test. Treat the prior favorable PEER diagnostic as retrospective cause-decomposition evidence only; do not rescue-tune.

INCONCLUSIVE.condition: Any other valid combination, including aggregate tie within tolerance, aggregate/block-sign conflict, or exactly 2 favorable and 2 unfavorable blocks.
INCONCLUSIVE.meaning: Do not claim replication or rejection; do not add seeds or tune the candidate under this gate.

mechanical_and_leakage_pass_criteria: Fresh origin/main remains descendant of the observed main and exact relevant governance/source blobs are unchanged
Owner gate and this prespec blobs match exactly
candidate function and helper contain no latent_skill, world_joint_distribution, _static_utilities or _line_strengths reference
candidate consumes only PRE-visible score/line_group_id/line_size/car_no plus frozen C1 utilities
for non-singletons, peer count equals line_size - 1 and peer mean equals direct PRE same-line target-excluded arithmetic mean within 1e-12
C0/C1/N1 reproduce their normal frozen paths exactly
all probability objects have expected support, finite nonnegative probabilities and unit mass
no protected/quarantined/real/economic access and scientific Segment C scoring count remains 0
post_result_rule: Record PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE regardless of direction, freeze portable evidence, do not reinterpret this Synthetic result as real-world edge, and fail closed before any real-world validation, feature expansion, coefficient search, alternate normalization, or economics.
